highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 updates the Skia engine to milestone 150 and adds new image and color filter APIs.
highlights_body: It adds SKImageFilter crop/empty helpers, an overdraw color filter, and a fast-bounds query on SKPaint, alongside a faster SKSurface canvas path and a raster blur regression fix.

bullets.detail: Bundles the Skia m150 engine, including a rolled-up batch of upstream chrome/m150 bug fixes, and updates the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1.

bullets.lead: New image and color filter helpers
bullets.detail: Adds SKImageFilter.CreateCrop() and CreateEmpty(), SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw() for overdraw visualization, and SKPaint.GetFastBounds() for quick-reject culling.
Promotes remaining pre-v4 obsolete members to compile errors and trims obsolete enum values from the reference assembly; also drops the deprecated .NET Interactive (Polyglot Notebooks) support.
Defines SK_AVOID_SLOW_RASTER_PIPELINE_BLURS to fix a small-sigma raster blur regression.
SKSurface now caches its Canvas wrapper across calls instead of recreating it each time.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: The raster blur regression fix, the SKSurface Canvas-caching performance work, and the pre-v4 obsolete cleanup
